column2: A step that takes time, with no limit on how many entities it works on at once.
column3: Korak, ki traja nekaj časa, brez omejitve, koliko entitet obdeluje hkrati.

column2: A step done by a limited number of units, such as machines or clerks. Entities wait in its waiting room until a unit is free.
column3: Korak, ki ga opravlja omejeno število enot, na primer strojev ali uradnikov. Entitete čakajo v njegovi čakalnici, dokler se enota ne sprosti.

column2: A step that borrows units from a pool that several tasks share, such as a team of nurses.
column3: Korak, ki si izposodi enote iz skupine, ki si jo deli več nalog, na primer ekipe medicinskih sester.

column2: The block where entities leave the model; it counts them and their time in the system.
column3: Blok, kjer entitete zapustijo model; prešteje jih in izmeri njihov čas v sistemu.

column2: Sends each entity down one of its ways out, by chance or by a condition.
column3: Pošlje vsako entiteto po enem od svojih izhodov, naključno ali glede na pogoj.

column2: How many entities a task with a resource can work on at the same time: its machines, clerks or beds.
column3: Koliko entitet lahko naloga z virom obdeluje hkrati: njeni stroji, uradniki ali postelje.

column2: Where entities wait for a free unit (a queue). It can have a limit; an entity that finds it full is lost or waits upstream.
column3: Kjer entitete čakajo na prosto enoto (vrsta). Lahko ima omejitev; entiteta, ki jo najde polno, se izgubi ali čaka v prejšnjem koraku.

column2: How long a unit takes with one entity, drawn from a distribution each time.
column3: Koliko časa enota porabi za eno entiteto; vsakič izžrebano iz porazdelitve.

column2: How a time or a quantity varies from one entity to the next: its shape and its mean.
column3: Kako se čas ali količina spreminja od ene entitete do druge: njena oblika in povprečje.

column2: One pass of the model from start to end with its own random numbers. Textbooks call it a replication.
column3: En prehod modela od začetka do konca z lastnimi naključnimi števili. Učbeniki temu pravijo ponovitev.

column2: All the runs together, with the same settings: how many runs, the seed, the warm-up and the time measured.
column3: Vsi zagoni skupaj z enakimi nastavitvami: koliko zagonov, seme, ogrevanje in merjeni čas.

column2: The starting point of the random numbers. The same model with the same seed always gives the same results.
column3: Izhodišče naključnih števil. Isti model z istim semenom vedno da enake rezultate.

column2: Time at the start of each run that is simulated but not measured, so an empty model filling up does not pull the results.
column3: Čas na začetku vsakega zagona, ki je simuliran, a ne merjen, da polnjenje praznega modela ne popači rezultatov.

column2: The share of the time a task's units are busy, counted over the time they are on shift.
column3: Delež časa, ko so enote naloge zasedene, štet v času, ko so v izmeni.

column2: The average time an entity spends in a waiting room before a unit takes it.
column3: Povprečni čas, ki ga entiteta preživi v čakalnici, preden jo prevzame enota.

column2: The average number of entities in a waiting room, over the time measured.
column3: Povprečno število entitet v čakalnici v merjenem času.

column2: How long an entity spends from its arrival to its departure, waiting and being worked on.
column3: Koliko časa entiteta preživi od prihoda do odhoda, s čakanjem in obdelavo.

column2: A unit has finished but cannot pass the entity on, because the next waiting room is full.
column3: Enota je končala, vendar entitete ne more predati naprej, ker je naslednja čakalnica polna.

column2: A unit is free but has no entity to work on.
column3: Enota je prosta, vendar nima entitete za obdelavo.

column2: Written ± after a mean: how far the true mean could plausibly be from the one shown. More runs narrow it.
column3: Zapisan kot ± za povprečjem: kako daleko je lahko pravo povprečje od prikazanega. Več zagonov ga zoži.

column2: A result known well enough to act on: to ± 5% of its mean, or ± 1 percentage point for a share.
column3: Rezultat, znan dovolj dobro, da lahko na njegovi podlagi ukrepate: na ± 5% povprečja ali ± 1 odstotna točka za delež.

column2: Results kept to compare a later run with, to see what a change to the model did.
column3: Rezultati, shranjeni za primerjavo s poznejšim zagonom, da vidite, kaj je naredila sprememba modela.

column2: A difference whose 95% interval takes in zero: the runs cannot tell it from random variation.
column3: Razlika, katere 95-odstotni interval vsebuje ničlo: zagoni je ne morejo ločiti od naključnega nihanja.

column2: A belt that carries entities from one end to the other. It has a length and a speed, and each entity takes a pitch of belt: its item length plus the gap kept free after it. column3: Število v pogoju za ustavitev za {block} nastavite na 1 ali več.

column3: Pogoj za ustavitev čaka, da se {block} izprazni, vendar se lahko izprazni samo naloga. Izberite nalogo.

column2: The stop condition at {block} can be met before the warm-up ends. A run that stops during the warm-up has no statistics after it and is left out of the results. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.
column3: Pogoj za ustavitev na bloku {block} je lahko izpolnjen pred koncem ogrevanja. Zagon, ki se ustavi med ogrevanjem, nima statistike po njem in je izpuščen iz rezultatov. Skrajšajte ogrevanje ali se ustavite pozneje.

column2: Every run stopped before the warm-up ended, so no metric is reported. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.
column3: Vsi zagoni so se ustavili pred koncem ogrevanja, zato ni prikazan noben kazalnik. Skrajšajte ogrevanje ali se ustavite pozneje.

column2: {replications} of {of} runs stopped before the warm-up ended, so their statistics are left out of every metric. Shorten the warm-up, or stop later.

column2: {block} is busy {utilisation}% of the time, and at the end at least {backlog} entities are still waiting against {left} that left. Work arrives faster than it is done, so the results describe no steady state. Add units, or shorten the service.
column3: {block} je zaseden {utilisation}% časa, na koncu pa še vedno čaka vsaj {backlog} entitet, odšlo pa jih je {left}. Delo prihaja hitreje, kot se opravlja, zato rezultati ne opisujejo ustaljenega stanja. Dodajte enote ali skrajšajte strežbo.

column2: The experiment has one run, so its results cannot be told from chance. Set the number of runs to at least 2, and usually 10 or more.
column3: Poskus ima en zagon, zato rezultatov ni mogoče ločiti od naključja. Število zagonov nastavite na vsaj 2, običajno pa na 10 ali več.

column2: {block} has a three-point estimate but no time to fit it to, so the estimate is ignored. Remove the estimate.
column3: {block} ima tritočkovno oceno, vendar nima časa, ki bi ga z njo prilagodili, zato se ocena prezre. Odstranite oceno.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: every point must be a finite number. Correct the points.
column3: Tritočkovne ocene bloka {block} ni mogoče prilagoditi: vsaka točka mora biti končno število. Popravite točke.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: the points must be in order, minimum, most likely, then maximum or 95th percentile. Correct the points.
column3: Tritočkovne ocene bloka {block} ni mogoče prilagoditi: točke morajo biti po vrstnem redu, najmanjša vrednost, najverjetnejša vrednost, nato največja vrednost ali 95. percentil. Popravite točke.

column2: The three-point estimate of {block} cannot be fitted: log-normal and Weibull estimates have no maximum. Give a 95th percentile instead.
column3: Tritočkovne ocene bloka {block} ni mogoče prilagoditi: lognormalne in Weibullove ocene nimajo največje vrednosti. Namesto tega podajte 95. percentil.

column2: The time of {block} is no longer the one fitted from its three-point estimate. Fit it again, or remove the estimate.
column3: Čas bloka {block} ni več tisti, prilagojen iz njegove tritočkovne ocene. Prilagodite ga znova ali odstranite oceno.

column2: In “{field}” of {block}, the normal distribution draws below 0 more than 1 time in 100, and each such draw counts as 0, so the times are longer on average than its mean. Use a truncated normal with a minimum of 0, or a log-normal.
column3: V polju »{field}« bloka {block} normalna porazdelitev izžreba vrednosti pod 0 pogosteje kot v enem od 100 izžrebov, vsak tak izžreb pa se šteje za 0, zato so časi v povprečju daljši od njenega povprečja. Uporabite odrezano normalno z najmanjšo vrednostjo 0 ali lognormalno.

column2: The entities of {block} do not add up: {came} came in or were inside at the start, but {went} left, were lost, gave up or are still inside.

column2: The entities of the model do not add up: {came} were created or inside at the start, but {went} reached Departures, left the model elsewhere or are still inside.

column2: The entities going round the closed model are stuck, of {came} created or inside at the start: no block where they were at the end finished any during the run. Check that every block of the loop can serve them and that the run is long enough for an entity to get round.
column3: Entitete, ki krožijo v zaprtem modelu, so obtičale, od {came} ustvarjenih ali na začetku notri: noben blok, v katerem so bile na koncu, med zagonom ni dokončal nobene. Preverite, ali jih lahko vsak blok zanke postreže in ali je zagon dovolj dolg, da entiteta naredi krog.

column2: Little's law does not hold at {block}: the time-average number inside was {mean}, but the entities' own times inside give {from_stays}.
column3: Littleov zakon ne velja pri bloku {block}: časovno povprečno število notri je bilo {mean}, lastni časi entitet notri pa dajo {from_stays}.

column3: Izkoriščenost bloka {block} šteje povprečno {busy} zasedenih enot, vendar jih je {working} obdelovalo ali se pripravljalo: enote, ki mirujejo, so blokirane, zunaj izmene, v okvari ali se znova zaganjajo, so bile štete kot zasedene.

column2: The utilisation of {block} counts {busy} units busy on average, but {working} were processing or setting up: units at work were not counted busy.

»{metric}« bloka {block} je {value}, zunaj območja od 0 do 1 (0% do 100%).

column3: Delo se takoj ustavi: entiteta se vrne na začetek čakalnice za kateri koli strežnik v izmeni, delo, opravljeno na njej, pa je zapravljeno.

column1: # Monte Carlo models in the window (ROADMAP M4.1, part 2)

column2: A Monte Carlo model: uncertain durations, day rate and materials, and the chance the cost or the duration runs over.
column3: Model Monte Carlo: negotova trajanja, dnevna postavka in material ter verjetnost, da bodo stroški ali trajanje preseženi.

column2: A calculation with uncertain inputs, not a process: each trial draws every input once and works out every output from them.
column3: Izračun z negotovimi vhodi, ne proces: vsaka iteracija enkrat izžreba vsak vhod in iz njih izračuna vsak izhod.

column2: A rank correlation between two inputs, from -1 to 1: above 0 they tend to be high together, below 0 one tends to be high when the other is low. Inputs not paired here are independent; 0 removes a pair.
column3: Korelacija rangov med dvema vhodoma, od -1 do 1: nad 0 sta navadno hkrati visoka, pod 0 je eden navadno visok, ko je drugi nizek. Vhodi, ki tu niso v paru, so neodvisni; 0 odstrani par.

column2: A {percent} chance that {output} is less than {value}.
column3: Verjetnost {percent}, da je vrednost {output} manjša od {value}.

column2: A {percent} chance that {output} is more than {value}.
column3: Verjetnost {percent}, da je vrednost {output} večja od {value}.

column2: About a 1 in {odds} chance that {output} is less than {value} ({percent}).
column3: Približno 1 možnost od {odds}, da je vrednost {output} manjša od {value} ({percent}).

column2: About a 1 in {odds} chance that {output} is more than {value} ({percent}).
column3: Približno 1 možnost od {odds}, da je vrednost {output} večja od {value} ({percent}).

column2: Each input is a distribution: every trial draws one value from it.
column3: Vsak vhod je porazdelitev: vsaka iteracija iz nje izžreba eno vrednost.

column2: Each output is worked out in every trial from the inputs and the outputs above it, each named as $name: for example $labour * $rate + $materials. Give it a target to see the chance of meeting it.
column3: Vsak izhod se v vsaki iteraciji izračuna iz vhodov in izhodov nad njim, vsak poimenovan kot $name: na primer $labour * $rate + $materials. Določite mu cilj, da vidite verjetnost, da bo dosežen.

column3: Koliko iteracij je dalo posamezno vrednost

column3: V 9 iteracijah od 10 je vrednost {output} med {low} in {high}; povprečje je {mean} ± {half_width}.

column2: In 9 trials out of 10, {output} is between {low} and {high}; the mean is {mean}.
column3: V 9 iteracijah od 10 je vrednost {output} med {low} in {high}; povprečje je {mean}.

column3: Vzorčenje z latinsko hiperkocko razdeli razpon vsakega vhoda na enako verjetne plasti in iz vsakega izžreba eno vrednost, kar običajno naredi rezultate natančnejše. Z njim ali s koreliranimi vhodi iteracije tečejo v celih serijah po 1000.

Antithetic pairs make each trial's twin from the opposite end of every input's range, so their errors tend to cancel, which usually makes the results more precise for the same trials. Trials run in pairs; it cannot be used with correlated inputs.
